import re, shutil, pathlib

rc = pathlib.Path("/root/.bashrc")
shutil.copy2(rc, "/root/.bashrc.bak-klee")
text = rc.read_text()

BLOCK = '''# >>> KLEE (symbolic execution engine, built with the STP solver, LLVM 16) >>>
# Keep this block ABOVE the "[ -z "$PS1" ] && return" guard below: a
# non-interactive shell (e.g. `bash -c 'source ~/.bashrc; ...'`) would
# otherwise return before reaching these exports.
export KLEE_INSTALL_PREFIX="/usr/local"
# `klee`, `kleaver`, `klee-stats`, ... live in /usr/local/bin
case ":${PATH}:" in
  *":/usr/local/bin:"*) ;;
  *) export PATH="/usr/local/bin${PATH:+:${PATH}}" ;;
esac
# KLEE headers: `#include <klee/klee.h>` resolves without extra -I flags
case ":${CPATH:-}:" in
  *":/usr/local/include:"*) ;;
  *) export CPATH="/usr/local/include${CPATH:+:${CPATH}}" ;;
esac
# KLEE runtime bitcode (libkleeRuntime*.bca) and the STP shared library
export KLEE_RUNTIME_LIBRARY_DIR="${KLEE_RUNTIME_LIBRARY_DIR:-/usr/local/lib/klee/runtime}"
case ":${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}:" in
  *":/usr/local/lib:"*) ;;
  *) export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}" ;;
esac
# <<< KLEE >>>
'''

# Idempotent: strip any previous block, then insert before the PS1 guard,
# falling back to the top of the file if the guard has moved.
text = re.sub(r'# >>> KLEE .*?<<< KLEE >>>\n', '', text, flags=re.S)
guard = '[ -z "$PS1" ] && return'
if guard in text:
    text = text.replace(guard, BLOCK + '\n' + guard, 1)
else:
    text = BLOCK + '\n' + text
rc.write_text(text)
print("inserted before guard:", guard in rc.read_text())
